messages:
alex: customer (AcmePay) reporting repeated session terminations mid-response when phone switches between office WiFi -> 5G. they get a partial JSON payload, then the stream ends.

maria: thanks. which client & SDK? is this SSE or websockets?

alex: iOS app using our JS SDK wrapper v1.3.2 hitting /v1/stream/generate (SSE). reported on iOS 16.5 and one Android 13 repro.

sre_jordan: can you paste the client console / network logs? common culprits: token refresh TTL, TCP FIN from client, or proxy idle timeouts.

alex: attached excerpt from user logs: 
```
SSE: connected (200)
chunk: {"id":"r1","delta":"partial text..."}
chunk: {"id":"r1","delta":"more text..."}
ERROR: connection closed by client
clientReason: network-change
```

eng_oncall: server side shows 499 (client closed) for that session id. Not seeing application-level error. Proxy in front shows keepalive gap ~18s before teardown.

maria: heap of customers see short gaps during network switch. what are their keepalive/heartbeat config?

alex: customer was on default SDK keepalive (30s). mobile was switching networks, hole in TCP for ~12s. we see partial chunk then close.

sre_jordan: suggestion: reduce client-side keepalive/ping to 10s for mobile clients to survive NAT rebinding/handovers; also enable automatic reconnect/resume in the SDK so partial outputs aren't considered final.

eng_oncall: also check token rotation: if refresh triggers while socket is midstream and client tears socket before retry, server sees client close. add logging around token refresh windows.

alex: maria — can you ask AcmePay to try the debug build with keepalive=8s and auto-resume=true? steps to repro we gave: 1) start streaming generation 2) toggle WiFi off/on 3) wait to see partial output + disconnect.

maria: done. they repro'd reliably on pixel 6 + iPhone 13. customer says shorter keepalive reduced disconnects, but still saw 1/10 attempts failing with truncated JSON.

sre_jordan: ok escalate: assign to eng-runtime for fallback behavior. paste lightweight repro tcpdump & proxy logs.

eng_oncall: opening ticket INF-7643. initial ask: add server-side tolerant framing: if client resumes quickly (within 30s), allow reattach to same session id and stream the remaining delta; fallback: ensure final chunk is well-formed JSON (server-side flush on abrupt close so partial chunk doesn't break client parsers).

alex: i'll collect tcpdump from AcmePay and forward. also include SDK logs for token refresh timing. thanks all. :thumbsup:

support-bot: Escalation created: INF-7643. Priority: P2. Assigned: eng-runtime, sre.

maria: follow-up — suggested doc for customers: "mobile best-practices for streaming" with recommended keepalive=8-12s, resume enabled, and guidance for token TTL >= stream duration + 30s. i'll draft it after eng confirms reattach feasibility.

eng_oncall: noted. If reattach isn't feasible quickly, we'll at minimum ensure the server truncation doesn't emit malformed JSON and add debug headers on disconnect for better triage.

alex: closing loop once I upload traces.
